<!-- Setup -->
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6, dpi = 150)

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(forcats)
library(lubridate)
library(zoo)
```

<!-- Data Loading --> 
```{r load-data, cache=TRUE}
files <- c(
  "Africa_aggregated_data_up_to-2026-02-28.xlsx",
  "Asia-Pacific_aggregated_data_up_to-2026-02-28.xlsx",
  "Europe-Central-Asia_aggregated_data_up_to-2026-02-28.xlsx",
  "Latin-America-the-Caribbean_aggregated_data_up_to-2026-02-28.xlsx",
  "Middle-East_aggregated_data_up_to-2026-02-28.xlsx",
  "US-and-Canada_aggregated_data_up_to-2026-02-28.xlsx"
)

combined <- lapply(files, read_xlsx) |> bind_rows()

combined <- combined |>
  mutate(
    WEEK = as.Date(WEEK),
    YEAR = year(WEEK),
    BROAD_REGION = case_when(
      REGION %in% c("Northern Africa", "Eastern Africa", "Western Africa",
                    "Middle Africa",   "Southern Africa")        ~ "Africa",
      REGION %in% c("South Asia", "Southeast Asia",
                    "East Asia", "Oceania")                      ~ "Asia-Pacific",
      REGION %in% c("Caucasus and Central Asia", "Europe")       ~ "Europe & C. Asia",
      REGION %in% c("South America", "Central America",
                    "Caribbean")                                  ~ "Latin America",
      REGION == "Middle East"                                     ~ "Middle East",
      REGION == "North America"                                   ~ "N. America",
      TRUE                                                        ~ "Other"
    )
  )

civ_fat <- read_xlsx("number_of_reported_civilian_fatalities_by_country-year_as-of-06Mar2026.xlsx")
tot_fat <- read_xlsx("number_of_reported_fatalities_by_country-year_as-of-06Mar2026.xlsx")
```

```{r plot-world-heatmap}
library(maps)

world_map <- map_data("world")

country_fat_total <- tot_fat |>
  filter(YEAR < 2026) |>
  group_by(COUNTRY) |>
  summarise(total = sum(FATALITIES, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(COUNTRY = recode(COUNTRY,
    "United States"          = "USA",
    "United Kingdom"         = "UK",
    "Democratic Republic of Congo" = "Democratic Republic of the Congo",
    "Republic of Congo"      = "Republic of Congo",
    "Czechia"                = "Czech Republic",
    "North Macedonia"        = "Macedonia",
    "Eswatini"               = "Swaziland",
    "Trinidad and Tobago"    = "Trinidad",
    "Antigua and Barbuda"    = "Antigua",
    "Saint Kitts and Nevis"  = "Saint Kitts",
    "Palestine"              = "Palestine"
  ))

map_joined <- world_map |>
  left_join(country_fat_total, by = c("region" = "COUNTRY"))

ggplot(map_joined, aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group, fill = total)) +
  geom_polygon(colour = "#1a1a1a", linewidth = 0.08) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours  = c("#f7e6e0", "#e8a090", "#C0392B", "#7b1010", "#3d0000"),
    na.value = "#d0d0d0",
    name     = "Fatalities",
    labels   = comma,
    trans    = "log10",                  # log scale so smaller countries stay visible
    breaks   = c(100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 250000)
  ) +
  coord_quickmap() +
  labs(
    title    = "Cumulative Reported Fatalities by Country (all years)",
    subtitle = "Log scale · grey = no data · darker red = more deaths",
    caption  = "Source: ACLED"
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 13) 
```

```{r plot-top15}
top15 <- tot_fat |>
  filter(YEAR < 2026) |>
  group_by(COUNTRY) |>
  summarise(total = sum(FATALITIES, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  slice_max(total, n = 15) |>
  left_join(
    civ_fat |>
      filter(YEAR < 2026) |>
      group_by(COUNTRY) |>
      summarise(civilian = sum(FATALITIES, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop"),
    by = "COUNTRY"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    non_civilian = total - civilian,
    COUNTRY      = fct_reorder(COUNTRY, total)
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(civilian, non_civilian),
               names_to = "type", values_to = "fatalities") |>
  mutate(type = recode(type,
    "civilian"     = "Civilian",
    "non_civilian" = "Non-civilian"
  ))

ggplot(top15, aes(x = COUNTRY, y = fatalities, fill = type)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Civilian" = "#C0392B", "Non-civilian" = "#BDC3C7"),
    name   = NULL
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title    = "Top 15 Deadliest Countries (all years)",
    subtitle = "Red = civilian fatalities · grey = non-civilian",
    x        = NULL,
    y        = "Reported fatalities",
    caption  = "Source: ACLED"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "#1a2744"),
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(colour = "#666", size = 11),
    plot.caption       = element_text(colour = "#999", size = 9),
    legend.position    = "bottom",
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r plot-region-composition}
event_pal <- c(
  "Battles"                    = "#C0392B",
  "Explosions/Remote violence" = "#E67E22",
  "Violence against civilians" = "#8E44AD",
  "Protests"                   = "#2980B9",
  "Riots"                      = "#16A085",
  "Strategic developments"     = "#95A5A6"
)

region_comp <- combined |>
  filter(BROAD_REGION != "Other", YEAR >= 2016) |>
  group_by(BROAD_REGION, EVENT_TYPE) |>
  summarise(Events = sum(EVENTS, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(BROAD_REGION) |>
  mutate(
    Share        = Events / sum(Events),
    BROAD_REGION = fct_reorder(BROAD_REGION, Events, .fun = sum, .desc = FALSE)
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(EVENT_TYPE = factor(EVENT_TYPE, levels = names(event_pal)))

ggplot(region_comp, aes(x = BROAD_REGION, y = Share, fill = EVENT_TYPE)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = event_pal, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title    = "Conflict Event Composition by Region (2016–2026)",
    subtitle = "Each bar sums to 100% - shows the dominant mode of conflict per region",
    x        = NULL,
    y        = "Share of events",
    caption  = "Source: ACLED"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "#1a2744"),
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(colour = "#666", size = 11),
    plot.caption       = element_text(colour = "#999", size = 9),
    legend.position    = "bottom",
    legend.key.size    = unit(0.4, "cm"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank()
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2))
```

```{r plot-ukraine-weekly}
ukraine_weekly <- combined |>
  filter(COUNTRY == "Ukraine", YEAR >= 2020) |>
  group_by(WEEK) |>
  summarise(
    Fatalities = sum(FATALITIES, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups    = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(WEEK) |>
  mutate(rolling_avg = rollmean(Fatalities, k = 4, fill = NA, align = "right"))

ggplot(ukraine_weekly, aes(x = WEEK)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = Fatalities), fill = "#C0392B", alpha = 0.4, width = 5) +
  geom_line(aes(y = rolling_avg), colour = "#C0392B", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = as.Date("2022-02-24"),
             linetype = "dashed", colour = "#1a2744", linewidth = 0.8) +
  annotate("text",
           x     = as.Date("2022-05-01"),
           y     = max(ukraine_weekly$Fatalities, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.95,
           label = "Full-scale invasion\n24 Feb 2022",
           hjust = 0, colour = "#1a2744", size = 3.5, fontface = "italic") +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "6 months", date_labels = "%b %Y") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(
    title    = "Ukraine - Weekly Reported Fatalities (2020–2026)",
    subtitle = "Bars = weekly count · line = 4-week rolling average",
    x        = NULL,
    y        = "Fatalities",
    caption  = "Source: ACLED"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "#1a2744"),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(colour = "#666", size = 11),
    plot.caption     = element_text(colour = "#999", size = 9),
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r plot1-global-trend}
yearly <- combined |>
  filter(YEAR >= 2010, YEAR <= 2025) |>
  group_by(YEAR) |>
  summarise(
    Events     = sum(EVENTS,     na.rm = TRUE),
    Fatalities = sum(FATALITIES, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups    = "drop"
  )

scale_factor <- max(yearly$Events) / max(yearly$Fatalities)

ggplot(yearly, aes(x = YEAR)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = Events), fill = "#2980B9", alpha = 0.8, width = 0.7) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Fatalities * scale_factor),
            colour = "#C0392B", linewidth = 1.3) +
  geom_point(aes(y = Fatalities * scale_factor),
             colour = "#C0392B", size = 3, shape = 21,
             fill = "white", stroke = 1.8) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2010:2025) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name     = "Events recorded",
    labels   = comma,
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / scale_factor, name = "Reported fatalities", labels = comma)
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "Global Conflict Events and Fatalities, 2010–2025",
    subtitle = "Bars = events (left axis)  ·  Line = fatalities (right axis)",
    x        = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "#1a2744"),
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(colour = "#666", size = 11),
    axis.title.y.left  = element_text(colour = "#2980B9"),
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(colour = "#C0392B"),
    axis.text.x        = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank()
  )
```
